content: Salicylic acid (SA) functions as a critical signaling molecule in the defense mechanisms of plants. A specific SA-response element (SARE) has been identified within the tobacco PR2-d gene. A 76 base pair (bp) fragment of this gene was shown to mediate a 20-fold increase in expression in response to SA in transgenic tobacco plants. Protein binding assays have demonstrated that the core sequence of this SARE is TTCGACCTCC.
